meta.title: BOOKFLOW — Beauty & wellness booking
meta.description: Two-sided platform: salon management for professionals, online booking for clients.

home.title: Online booking,
home.subtitle: An independent platform: the business core for providers (management, scheduling, payments) and a smooth client journey (discovery, booking, follow-up).
home.b2bDesc: Two plans: Essential (listing + booking + scheduling) and Premium (+ POS and advanced features).
home.b2cDesc: Simple flow: choose a salon, a service, a time slot — then manage appointments from your account.
